# Merge-rule gate (R1 / R2 / R3)

**Provenance.** Run `zeroshot500_qwen35_4b_img_only_keyed_42b812b`, generated by `uv run python scripts/rule_gate.py` (repo state `6b027eb+dirty`; paired bootstrap 2000 doc-level resamples, seed 42; unmodified scorer via `shipdoc.eval`). Rules: `src/shipdoc/rules.py`, applied to merged doc dicts before schema coercion. **All numbers UNVERIFIED** until a verifier recomputes them. Aggregates and counts only.

**Ship rule.** SHIP iff the paired 95% CI of delta OVERALL excludes 0 (lower bound > 0) AND broken == 0. R3 additionally requires no group with net < 0. Otherwise DO NOT SHIP, naming the failed clause. R1 / R2 (no learned parameters) are decided on the TRAIN docs only; R3 (shapes learned from gold) is decided supplier-held-out, folds pooled, on the train + dev docs of `splits/folds.json`.

## R2 deployment cost

R2 needs OCR (PaddleOCR, run on Colab for the test set) at inference time, a different deployment cost from the image-only pick. R2 with OCR touches 20 cells (fixed 20, broken 0); the OCR-free variant (pattern searched only in the model's own raw output) touches 0 cells (fixed 0, broken 0). A model that emitted null for a field has usually not printed the value anywhere else in its output, so the OCR-free variant recovers 0 of the 20 cells the OCR variant fixes: R2's gain is not available to the image-only pipeline without OCR at inference time.

# R3 supplier-held-out

Shapes for each fold come only from the gold of the OTHER folds' docs (supplier groups are disjoint across folds, checked at run time); the folds are pooled so every doc is evaluated once. The dev docs are inside this pooling, so R3 has no separate dev confirmation.
